title: Every automatic follow-up email counts toward the one a day, three a week limit

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (project thread: Check every email and message system)

detail: LIFECYCLE_CAP_ENABLED=1 in production since 2026-11-17 (Daniel approved EMAIL-047: at most one lifecycle email a day and three a week per person). The cap only applies where a sender calls reserveLifecycleSend, and on 2026-11-18 only the nurture runner does (docs/RUNBOOKS.md: 'other senders join as their PRs land'). lifecycle_send_log is empty in production. The launch come-back (lib/launch/comeback-io.ts), launched welcome (rank 1, counts toward the week), Create a Space draft reminders (lib/create-space/draft-recovery-io.ts) and operator day 0/1/3/7 (lib/marketing/operator-lifecycle.ts) all send uncapped, so one person can get a draft reminder, a come-back and an operator email the same day. Work: in each sender, reserve right before the enqueue with the registry kind and a stable dedupe key; a 'capped' answer must leave the step due for a later run (not claim its launch_email_log / draft log row), an 'error' skips this run, a 'duplicate' advances. Weekly digest, this-week and made-it are registered too; decide with the owner whether newsletters count toward the week before wiring them.

verify.note: Fails until every listed lifecycle sender reserves through the cap before it enqueues.
